description: This file defines the core rules engine for a Ludo game, including logic for determining legal moves, applying moves, handling turn transitions, and detecting game winners. It interacts with game state, piece positions, and game rules, leveraging other model and board classes.

classes.name: LudoRulesEngine
classes.description: A static utility class providing core game mechanics and rule enforcement for Ludo.

methods.name: legalMoves
methods.description: Returns a list of valid moves for the current active player based on game state and dice roll.

methods.name: applyMove
methods.description: Applies a specified move to the game state, updating piece positions, capturing opponent pieces, and checking for game end condition.

methods.name: endTurnIfNeeded
methods.description: Handles end-of-turn logic, including passing turn to the next player and managing extra roll availability.

methods.name: _advance
methods.description: Private method that computes the next position of a piece given current position and dice roll.

methods.name: _colorForPlayerIndex
methods.description: Private method that maps a player index to a specific LudoColor.

methods.name: _detectWinner
methods.description: Private method to determine if a player has won the game based on current positions.
